caption:

facts.claim: Vince Carter won the 1999 NBA Rookie of the Year Award and the Slam Dunk Contest at the 2000 NBA All-Star Weekend with Toronto.
Kawhi Leonard led the Raptors to their first NBA championship in 2019 and won Finals MVP.
Kyle Lowry became the Raptors' all-time leader in triple-doubles and the franchise leader in three-pointers; 2019 NBA champion with Toronto.
DeMar DeRozan became the Raptors franchise's all-time leading scorer.
Poll: one (1) name, four (4) options numbered 1, 2, 3, 4. ESPN player ids: Vince Carter 136, Kawhi Leonard 6450, Kyle Lowry 3012, DeMar DeRozan 3978.
